comment: cmd.c hangup() and end_of_input() witness. ^A repeats the farlook command, so getpos() reads its next key through pgetchar() with gi.in_doagain set. pgetchar() returns a signed char, so byte 0377 equals EOF; the NR_OF_EOFS loop reads twenty more 0377 bytes, and readchar_core() calls hangup(0). With a game in progress, hangup() swaps in the hangup window procedures, sets done_hup and returns. getpos() sees ESC, and the next moveloop_core() calls end_of_input() (allmain.c:182-183), which saves the game and exits without drawing anything.
